english: Move all items into Hyperdimensional Network
schinese: 将全部物品存入超维网络

english: Restock and search settings apply only to you. Network feature switches are administrator-only.
schinese: 补货与搜索设置只影响你自己。网络功能开关仅管理员可见和设置。

english: Sale mode enabled. Sell buttons are shown on sellable network items.
schinese: 已开启出售模式。可出售的网络物品旁将显示出售按钮。
已关闭虚空商人出售模式。

english: Virtual trader sale complete. Proceeds deposited to network:
schinese: 虚空商人出售完成，收益已存入网络：

english: Adds every registered item variant to your network up to its current stack limit. Quality items are added at every exposed quality level.
schinese: 将当前注册的所有物品变体按各自堆叠上限加入网络；有品质的物品会加入其全部可用等级。
超维网络极限压力测试

english: Adds every registered item variant. Stackable items are added at int32 maximum quantity per variant and will create an extremely large storage journal.
schinese: 将当前注册的所有物品变体加入网络；可堆叠物品的每个变体加入 int32 最大数量，会产生极端规模的数据。

english: Track a recipe to calculate its crafting chain.
schinese: 请先在原版制作界面追踪配方以计算合成链。

english: Could not calculate a safe crafting plan.
schinese: 无法计算安全的合成计划。

english: Crafting is not available for this plan yet.
schinese: 当前合成计划暂不能启动。
所需材料 / 可用数量

english: Cancel this crafting chain? Recoverable materials will be returned to the network.
schinese: 确定取消此合成链？可回收材料将退回网络。

english: A crafting chain is already running.
schinese: 当前已有合成链正在运行。

english: Wait for the network transaction to finish.
schinese: 请等待网络物品操作完成。

english: Clear the vanilla crafting queue before starting.
schinese: 请先清空原版制作队列。

english: Open and access the required workstation before starting.
schinese: 请先打开并确保可使用计划所需的工作站。

english: A required recipe is no longer available.
schinese: 计划中有配方当前不可用。

english: The requested output is already available.
schinese: 所需成品已在现有库存中。

english: Make room in your inventory to collect workstation output.
schinese: 请为工作站产物腾出背包空间。

english: Vanilla crafting finished without producing the planned amount.
schinese: 原版制作队列未产出计划中的数量，合成链已安全停止。

english: Returning unused order materials to the network...
schinese: 正在将剩余订单材料退回网络……

english: Order materials could not be returned yet; the chain will retry.
schinese: 订单材料暂时无法退回网络，合成链将重试。

english: Make room in your inventory to receive the remaining order materials.
schinese: 请为剩余订单材料腾出背包空间。

english: This crafting plan is too large to display safely.
schinese: 合成计划过于复杂，无法安全显示。

english: Output missing or queue changed. Deposit this node's product into the network to resume
column4: 产物缺失或队列被更改。将此节点需要的成品存入网络以继续，或取消订单。

schinese: 工作站已停止：燃料不足。

english: Workstation stopped: check fuel and operating state.
schinese: 工作站已停止：请检查燃料和运行状态。
